CREATE TABLE tag_usage_agg ( user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tag_id BIGINT NOT NULL, bucket VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, bucket_start DATE NOT NULL, usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_duration_minutes BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT pk_tag_usage_agg PRIMARY KEY (user_id, tag_id, bucket, bucket_start), CONSTRAINT fk_tag_usage_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_tag_usage_tag FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_tag_usage_user_bucket_start ON tag_usage_agg (user_id, bucket, bucket_start); CREATE INDEX idx_tag_usage_user_tag_bucket_start ON tag_usage_agg (user_id, tag_id, bucket, bucket_start);
